name: Bulk Meta Data Importer for Rank Math
author: Tuhin Bairagi

sections.description:
Rank Math Bulk Meta Data Importer is a WordPress plugin that allows users to upload a CSV file and update the Meta Title and Meta Description fields for URLs using the Rank Math SEO plugin.

This is useful for bulk SEO optimization, allowing quick updates without manually editing each post.

Features

  • Upload a CSV file to update Meta Titles and Meta Descriptions for multiple URLs.
  • Uses Rank Math SEO Plugin fields.
  • Simple and user-friendly admin interface.
  • Error handling and progress tracking.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Tools > Rank Math CSV Importer.
  4. Format your CSV file with the following headers:
    • URLs (Full post/page URL)
    • Meta Title
    • Meta Description
  5. Upload the CSV file and click Upload and Import.
